verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing describes a visual canvas that shows the entire stack at a glance and lets you modify settings directly on it, with YAML optional and auto-config. Every element of the story (visualize, edit, no config files) is documented by first-party claims. missing for 10: in-depth docs on which infrastructure elements can be edited on the canvas beyond 'settings', independent or hands-on corroboration of canvas-only editing.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can visualize and edit my entire infrastructure stack on a visual canvas without writing config files

citations.quote: Craft on a visual canvas that makes your entire stack visible at a glance.
Modify settings directly from the canvas. YAML optional.
Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
